scope: Six remaining S138/S139/S150/S190/S194 provisional men products checked at their full source resolution
boardTitle: Six Summer, Office and Date products · full-source audit
boardNote: One Premium hold revoked · one dated shirt rejected from catalog · four retained with exact use or metadata corrections · no outfit approval or UI integration

entries.label: Cream-Caramel Openwork Knit Shirt
entries.reason: The full worn source shows a breathable regular body, controlled shoulder and upper-hip hem. Keep only for warm Casual Mid-Range with a discreet underlayer and one simple straight bottom; the large dark buttons and open knit exclude Premium use.

entries.label: Cool-Taupe Clean Bermuda Short
entries.reason: The flat front and controlled knee-grazing leg are useful, but the ordinary fabric, basic fly and small gold trim read clean Mid-Range rather than Premium. Remove the S139 hold and keep only as an unassigned lower-tier Summer option.

entries.label: Pale-Aqua Pinstripe Button-Down
entries.reason: The source proves a clean button-down collar, regular shoulder and controlled relaxed body with cheerful Spring color. Correct Green Stripe to pale aqua pinstripe and keep for S150 creative Office with a clean tuck or restrained untucked hem.

entries.label: Light-Khaki Controlled-Taper Trouser
entries.reason: The full view is a clean regular thigh with a controlled taper and one precise shoe break, not the supplier's broad straight label and not skinny. Keep for S150 Office only with a regular top and low-profile loafer or derby.

entries.label: Warm-White Roll-Tab Band-Collar Shirt
entries.reason: The full source shows dropped shoulders, a long broad body, dated roll-tab sleeves and a conventional chest pocket. The warm-white color cannot rescue the generic silhouette; remove it from the accepted catalog and S190.

entries.label: Brown Distressed Faux-Leather Blouson
entries.reason: The cropped hip line, clean collar and controlled boxy body are current enough for one Fall Date look. Correct faux suede/taupe to distressed faux leather/mottled brown and require coral, ivory and burgundy pieces so the outfit never becomes muddy or dark.
